$\phantom{=}\blueD{1.4\cdot10^9}-1.1\cdot10^8$

question.content:
The table shown below gives the approximate distance from the sun for a few different planets.

**How much further (in $\text{km}$) from the sun is  Saturn than Venus?**  
*Express your answer in scientific notation.*

Planet | Approximate distance from the Sun (in $\text{km}$)
:-: | :-:  
Mercury | $5.8 \cdot 10^7$ 
Venus| $1.1 \cdot 10^8$ 
Earth | $1.5 \cdot 10^8$ 
Saturn | $1.4 \cdot 10^9$ 
Uranus| $3\cdot10^9$ 


[[☃ expression 1]] $\text{ km}$
